sections.kicker: Prepared for Purple Banana by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Purple Banana owns being first. The captions bury it under a feeling.
sections.keep: The purple storefront signs with the banana logo. You cannot miss the shop in a photo.

meet first.

pins.what: The bio holds the one claim only Purple Banana can make: the first açaí shop in Syracuse.
pins.why: First in town is a position nobody else can take.
pins.how: Make first açaí shop in Syracuse the headline and the history the proof.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Without it the shop is one more smoothie place.

pins.quote: offering only food that makes you feel good
pins.what: The reason given for the brand is a feeling every health food place promises.
pins.why: Food that makes you feel good is said by every juice bar.
pins.how: Say what makes Purple Banana's bowls different: the ingredients, the recipes, the people.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: Customers pick the nearest juice bar.

pins.quote: it’s time to put PB in your regular rotation
pins.what: PB means Purple Banana in one caption and peanut butter in another.
pins.why: The short name competes with a product the shop sells.
pins.how: Pick one short name and spell the other out.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: A nickname that means two things cannot become the brand.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Purple Banana. I spent some time on your Instagram. Three things stood out.
